name: Wong
owner: Cencosud S.A. (Chile) — Cencosud Retail Perú S.A.

logoSources.notes: Official app icon (512 px) of 'Supermercados Wong' by Cencosud SA on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cencosud.pe.wong): red disc with white 'Wong' wordmark, white outer ring and red dot. Only the white wordmark was lifted (outer ring and dot dropped) and centred on the icon red #F20E00 inside the circle-safe area. 2026-10-01: wordmark enlarged to ~88% of the badge square (it was ~72%).

Added 2026-10-01 so the card style shows a wordmark like the other chains: the same white 'Wong' wordmark lifted from the official Google Play icon (wong.pe itself only shows the Cencosud logo), painted in the icon red #F20E00, transparent, trimmed, 406x104 (the icon is 512 px; no upscaling).

Wikidata P154 logo (500 px, same circular design with 'cencosud' subline). Also File:Logo_Wong_(2005).svg (red wordmark): not used, its letterforms are older (the dot over the W, the round O and the spacing differ from the current app icon).

notes: Premium supermarket chain (founded 1942, Cencosud since 2007). Store count: Cencosud Memoria Integrada 2025, annex 'Perú | Supermercados' store list (name, address, owned/leased, m2) lists 20 'Wong ...' stores (Lima, Asia, Km40, Trujillo x2) — useful as an official address list for verification. Perú Retail (8 May 2026) also says 20. No store-locator page found on wong.pe (VTEX site; /tiendas is a product search). OSM (probe 2026-10-01): exactly 20 shop=supermarket objects match; none carry brand:wikidata. 'Wong' is a common surname in Peru: restaurants ('Chifa Wong ...'), clinics, a hotel, 'Wong Express' laundry, ATMs and parkings must not match — hence the start-anchored regex plus the shop filter; malls tagged operator 'Corporación Wong'/'Grupo Wong' (Plaza Norte, Mall del Sur) are unrelated to the supermarket chain. Match name before brand: w289710415 is name='Vivanda' with a stray Wong tag. The Memoria's Peru store list (names + addresses as printed) is extracted to tools/seed/chains/cencosud-peru-stores-2025.csv (88 rows: 68 Metro, 20 Wong; script tools/seed/logo-src/extract_cencosud_list.py).
